project_type: Electron desktop app (Node.js main process + Lit web components renderer, stealth overlay)
build_system: Electron Forge - no build step for source code, JS loaded directly via script tags. `npm start` runs `electron-forge start`.
test_framework: No test framework configured. AGENTS.md says 'No automated tests yet'. npm run lint just echoes 'No linting configured'.
build_command: No build command needed - plain JS. Validation: `node -e "require('./src/index.js')"` will partially verify syntax (Electron-specific requires will fail but syntax is checked).
test_command: No test command exists. Validation is AST/syntax-based only.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `node --check` on all new/modified JS files to verify syntax. 2. Run `node -e` require tests where possible (non-Electron modules). 3. Run prettier to verify formatting. Since this is an Electron app and we cannot run Electron in this sandbox, we rely on syntax validation and static analysis.
setup_instructions: 1. Install mise node (done - v24.16.0 at /root/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24.16.0/bin). 2. npm install (requires network). 3. npm start (requires Electron/display).
environment_constraints: No Electron runtime in sandbox (no display server). Cannot run the app. Validation limited to: node --check for syntax, node -e require() for non-Electron modules, prettier formatting. npm install may or may not work depending on network mode.
contribution_requirements: Run npx prettier --write . before committing (4-space indent, 150 print width, semicolons, single quotes). No linting. AGENTS.md mentions aspirational TypeScript migration but current code is plain JS.
key_patterns: Main process: CommonJS require/module.exports. Renderer: ES module imports from vendored Lit library. IPC: ipcMain.handle/ipcMain.on in main, ipcRenderer.invoke/ipcRenderer.on in renderer. Global state: window.cheatingDaddy object exposes all renderer APIs. Settings: storage.js reads/writes JSON files. Hotkeys: globalShortcut.register in window.js. Toast notifications: showToast() in renderer.js. Event bus: window.cheatingDaddy.events (EventTarget).
directory_structure: src/index.js - main process entry. src/utils/window.js - window creation, globalShortcut hotkeys. src/utils/gemini.js - AI session management, response streaming. src/utils/renderer.js - renderer utilities, storage wrapper, toast system, IPC listeners, global cheatingDaddy object. src/storage.js - JSON file persistence for all settings. src/components/ - Lit web components (views and app shell). src/assets/ - vendored libs (Lit, marked, highlight.js).
